info.title: Flightdeck API
info.description: Local-development API with deployment-fixed local authoring and read-only master observation. Dashboard mode and environment come only from validated server configuration; master mode is not production authentication. Signed local sessions remain loopback-only and demo-only. Flag identity is shared by project key, but metadata, lifecycle, archive state, revisions, gates and configurations are environment-local. Creating a flag initializes only the configured local environment, disabled. Reusable segments have independent drafts and immutable publication history. Published flag references follow current local published segment blocks (OR blocks, AND conditions) without republishing flags or changing flag revisions or gates; historical audit retains original snapshots. Catalog writes edit only local attributes. All operator mutations require local dashboard mode and the configured environment. Credentials grant explicit tenant contexts within one project/environment. Context and proposed configuration retain independent bounds inside a 64-KiB HTTP envelope. No context is stored as exposure or used as entitlement authorization. This is not a production-stable external API.

localSession.name: fd_local_session
localSession.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict signed development session, issued only by explicit loopback development startup. Not a production authentication protocol.

evaluationBearer.description: Backend-only fd_ token, restricted to one organization/project/environment, explicit tenant grants and evaluation; only its SHA256 verifier is stored. Context traits are asserted by the trusted backend caller, not browser authority.
